text: Did you know, that there is a way to quickly change your current skills?
zh: 你知道吗？有个办法可以快速切换你当前的技能。

text: I was told to hold '###input.INPUT_SKILL_QUICK_BAR###' and select a skill.
zh: 听说只要按住'###input.INPUT_SKILL_QUICK_BAR###'再选择一个技能就行。

text: Obviously, you need to have items equipped, which grant skills.
zh: 当然，你得先装备上能赋予技能的物品。

text: By the way... what exactly is '###input.INPUT_SKILL_QUICK_BAR###'?
zh: 话说回来……'###input.INPUT_SKILL_QUICK_BAR###'到底是个什么东西？

text: But what do I know? I am just an NPC.
zh: 不过我懂什么呢？我只是个NPC罢了。
